question: The Union Budget 2024-25 outlines a comprehensive strategy to achieve 'Viksit Bharat' by focusing on _______ key priorities that aim to create abundant opportunities for all citizens. Together, these initiatives are designed to propel India towards a developed nation status.
solution:
The correct answer is __**nine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Union Budget 2024-25** focuses on **nine key priorities** to achieve the goal of '**Viksit Bharat**' or Developed India.
 
• These priorities aim to create abundant opportunities for all citizens, ensuring inclusive growth and development.
 
• The strategy is designed to propel India towards becoming a developed nation by addressing critical areas such as infrastructure, healthcare, education, and innovation.
 
• Key initiatives include investments in renewable energy, digital infrastructure, skill development, and social welfare programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Budget**

 
 
• The Union Budget is the** annual financial statement** presented by the Government of India, detailing its revenue and expenditure for the upcoming fiscal year.
 
• It is presented by the Finance Minister in Parliament and is a key policy document outlining the government's economic strategy and priorities.
 
• The budget includes proposals for taxation, government spending, and allocation of resources to various sectors.
 
• It plays a crucial role in shaping the economic and social policies of the country.
 
 
 
• **Inclusive Growth**
 
 
• Inclusive growth refers to economic growth that is distributed fairly across society and creates opportunities for all, particularly the disadvantaged.
 
• It aims to reduce poverty and inequality by ensuring that the benefits of growth reach every section of society.
 
• Policies for inclusive growth typically focus on education, healthcare, social protection, and employment generation.
 
• This approach ensures sustainable development by promoting social stability and equity.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development**
 
 
• Infrastructure development involves the construction and improvement of foundational services such as transportation, energy, water supply, and telecommunications.
 
• It is critical for economic growth as it enhances productivity, reduces costs, and improves the quality of life for citizens.
 
• Investment in infrastructure is a key priority for governments to boost economic activity and create jobs.
 
• Modern infrastructure also supports sustainable development by integrating green technologies and practices.
